notes.title: Demo drops September 5th for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [h3][b]Demo arriving September 5![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Get ready to dive into an intense preview of the Just Climb experience starting [b]September 5, 2025.[/b][/p][p]With vertical challenges, tension, and exploration, [b]this demo will plunge you right into the climb...[/b] but beware, every hold counts![/p][p][/p][h3][b]See you at Steam Next Fest – October 13 to 20[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Just Climb will officially participate in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] from [b]October 13 to 20, 2025![/b][/p][p]A unique opportunity to test the game, watch live gameplay, ask questions, and be part of the adventure.[/p][p]Don’t miss this key moment [b]to support indie games[/b] shaking up the gaming scene![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Support the project and join the community[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]✨ Add the game to your [b]Steam wishlist[/b][/p][p]🔔 Hit “[b]Follow[/b]” to stay updated on future announcements and support[/p][p]💬 Join the [b]Discord community[/b] to chat, share feedback, and never miss a thing[/p][p]🐦 Follow our [b]Twitter/X[/b] for behind-the-scenes, exclusive info, [i]and a little virtual sweat![/i][/p][p][/p][p]🕵️‍♂️ [i]One last tip for the curious: rumor has it the computer desktop… hides some mysterious secrets. (Only at the game’s release on October 31)[/i][/p]

notes.title: Just Climb hit 300+ wishlists – thank you all so much! 🙏
notes.content: [h3][b]A huge thank you to all of you for your support![/b] 🙏[/h3][p][/p][p]Thanks to your feedback, I’ve gathered lots of great ideas and will keep improving the game.[/p][p]Every wishlist and follow counts — they [u]help make [i]Just Climb[/i] even better![/u][/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 [b]The demo is just around the corner![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Pssst... [i]The demo will be available on September 5th, 2025[/i] 😉[/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to share the game with others and keep sending your feedback — whether it's on the forums, Discord, or social media. It really helps a lot! 🚀[/p]
